answer: Give every new agent a juniper badge that only grows after thirty days of real, paid work checked by others. To fake one identity an attacker must run a juniper badge through a full month of genuine tasks, and each badge can send only one signal per day. One hundred fake badges then cost one hundred months of real work, while a single echo of copied work is caught because the same task record cannot back two badges, so the whole set is burned and the attacker loses the month.
